retrieved_synopses: Karlach reacts to party meeting Jaheira.

The party has just witnessed Karlach take violent revenge on Gortash and then realize she is dying; she withdrew to camp to be alone. Returning to Avernus is presented as a possible way to save her life but would likely condemn her to servitude, so Karlach has made a grim, personal choice about what she will accept. Jaheira’s topical remarks are triggered by that event: she’s grim and unsentimental, urging space for Karlach while insisting the group be present and truthful rather than offer false hope. When the player asks Jaheira to persuade Karlach to return, Jaheira refuses, respecting Karlach’s autonomy and preferring honesty over imposed salvation.

context: The lines occur immediately after the party watched Karlach take violent revenge on Gortash and then realize she is dying; she has withdrawn to camp to be alone. Jaheira, who knows Karlach and has returned with the party from the confrontation, responds grimly and unsentimentally — urging the group to give Karlach space while also making sure she knows she is not abandoned. Returning to Avernus is presented as a possible cure but would almost certainly condemn Karlach to servitude, so Karlach has privately made a grim, personal choice about what she will accept. When the player asks Jaheira to persuade Karlach to go back, Jaheira refuses out of respect for Karlach’s autonomy and a refusal to offer false hope.
